extraArgs.description: node_exporter's own TLS server (--web.config.file) and the supervisord collector are not supported, and neither are @file arguments or $(VAR) references, which could supply them. Use the subchart's kubeRBACProxy and tlsSecret values for TLS.

env.description: Entries must have a non-empty string name. TEMPO_EXTRA_ARGS, BASH_ENV, and PATH are not supported, whether set with value or valueFrom. NKTP runs Tempo with the image's configuration, which enables OTLP receivers only.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Mount paths must be absolute and normalized, and must not replace /, /otel-lgtm, Tempo's configuration or binaries, or the image's top-level shell scripts. NKTP runs Tempo with the image's configuration, which enables OTLP receivers only.
